```{r 2025_station_changes}
# This should be elsewhere, but here we are.
# Douglas is Douglas Crossing, for now. It gets changed later

lw <- dat |>
  filter(Year == my.year) |>
  filter(
    str_detect(
      Station,
      "Lower Mainland.*(Outreach|Scheduled Inspection|Roving)|^Lower Mainland$"
    ),
    !str_detect(Station, "Douglas|Huntington")
  )

p_insp <- lw |>
  mutate(the.month = month(TimeOfInspection, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) |>
  filter(!(the.month %in% c("March","November") & Year == 2024)) |>
  group_by(the.month, Station) |>
  summarise(Number_Insp = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = the.month, y = Number_Insp, fill = Station)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Number_Insp),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Watercraft Encounters (# of inspections)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

p_effort <- lw |>
  filter(!Station %in% rovers_to_drop) |>
  mutate(the.month = month(TimeOfInspection, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) |>
  filter(!(the.month %in% c("March","November") & Year == 2024)) |>
  select(the.month, Station, Shift_ID, Shift_hours) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(Shift_hours > 0) |>
  group_by(the.month, Station) |>
  summarise(TotalEffort = sum(Shift_hours), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = the.month, y = TotalEffort, fill = Station)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(TotalEffort, 0)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Total Effort (hours)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

p5 <- ggarrange(p_insp, p_effort, ncol = 2, nrow = 1)


if(!interactive()) {

  ggsave(paste0(my.external.output.folder,'/GIS Maps and Excel Figures/ExcelFigures/Lower_Mainland_Outreach_Sch.jpg'), p5, width = 7.6, height = 6.4, dpi = 300)
}
```

<!-- Descriptor: how many 2025 records are missing a station, as context for what follows -->

```{r check-known-station-names-in-comments}
comment_has_known_station <- function(text, stations) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") return(FALSE)
  any(str_detect(text, regex(stations, ignore_case = TRUE)))
}

missing_stations <- missing_stations |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(
    station_in_general = comment_has_known_station(General_Comment, known_stations),
    station_in_shift    = comment_has_known_station(Shift_Start_Comment, known_stations)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

sum(missing_stations$station_in_general, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(missing_stations$station_in_shift, na.rm = TRUE)
```

<!-- Descriptor: confirms whether known station names ever appear directly in the free-text comments -->

```{r prep-comment-text}
comments_long <- missing_stations |> 
  select(General_Comment, Shift_Start_Comment) |> 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "comment_field", values_to = "text") |> 
  filter(!is.na(text), text != "")

comments_long |> count(comment_field)
```

```{r word-frequency}
word_freq <- comments_long |> 
  unnest_tokens(word, text) |> 
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") |> 
  count(word, sort = TRUE)

word_freq
```

<!-- Plot placeholder: word_freq bar chart of top n words -->
```{r plot-word-frequency, fig.cap="Most frequent words in comments on records with a missing station"}
word_freq |> 
  slice_max(n, n = 20) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(word, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count")
```

```{r bigram-frequency}
bigram_freq <- comments_long |> 
  unnest_tokens(bigram, text, token = "ngrams", n = 2) |> 
  separate(bigram, into = c("w1", "w2"), sep = " ") |> 
  filter(!w1 %in% stop_words$word, !w2 %in% stop_words$word) |> 
  unite(bigram, w1, w2, sep = " ") |> 
  count(bigram, sort = TRUE)

head(bigram_freq, 40)
```

```{r extract-shift-times}
time_pattern <- regex("\\b\\d{1,2}:?\\d{2}\\s?(am|pm)?\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)

missing_stations <- missing_stations |> 
  mutate(
    times_in_general = str_extract_all(General_Comment, time_pattern),
    times_in_shift    = str_extract_all(Shift_Start_Comment, time_pattern)
  )
```

<!-- Descriptor: pulls out any shift-time mentions for later cross-referencing -->

```{r extract-names}
name_pattern <- regex("\\b[A-Z][a-z]+\\s[A-Z][a-z]+\\b")

extract_names <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") return(NA_character_)
  hits <- str_extract_all(text, name_pattern)[[1]]
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  paste(unique(hits), collapse = "; ")
}

missing_stations <- missing_stations |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(
    name_from_general = extract_names(General_Comment),
    name_from_shift    = extract_names(Shift_Start_Comment),
    extracted_name = coalesce(name_from_general, name_from_shift)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

missing_stations |> summarise(n_with_name = sum(!is.na(extracted_name)), total = n())
```

<!-- Descriptor: candidate personal names extracted via Title-Case regex; review before trusting -->

```{r review-extracted-names}
missing_stations |> 
  filter(!is.na(extracted_name)) |> 
  count(extracted_name, sort = TRUE)
```
